claims.text: The remediated simulator has a declared and testable numerical process: exchange preserves total wealth and non-negativity, invalid state fails explicitly, random streams are seed- and stable-ID-keyed, controls execute the process named in the design, and required metrics have valid stationarity and precision diagnostics.
claims.resolution: V1F passed all six frozen calibration layers on 64 unseen seeds, including non-flat timestep convergence and a valid status for every required metric. Residual S18, that the frozen storage-order bound was measured at temperature 0.0 while the confirmatory reference configuration runs at temperature 0.5, was tested by V1G-ORDER-THERMAL-C4 and came back bounded: all four tail bounds fall under the frozen limits, so the bound covers the thermal-noise/row-order coupling and S18 is closed as quantified. The verdict carries two pre-registered reservations: occupancy_entropy uses 88% of its frozen limit, and 12 of 128 runs fail the per-run steady-window checks.
claims.falsification: Any required invariant or control-semantics test fails; a required metric is invalid/undefined without a preregistered not-applicable status; or non-flat timestep results do not converge within the frozen numerical tolerance.

claims.text: Under matched resource totals, histograms, accessible area, population, and initial wealth, clustered versus shuffled resource landscapes produce a numerically resolvable difference in preregistered steady-window spatial metrics.
claims.resolution: None of the pre-registered falsification conditions hold: the calibration is valid and non-flat (V1F), the paired effects sit far outside the frozen equivalence region, multiplicity control passes, and every required stationarity/precision gate passes. Scope is the calibrated reference configuration; system-size, density, grid-discretization and holdout-landscape generalization remain with C4-ROBUSTNESS-C4 (E3-ROBUSTNESS-C4, deferred).
claims.falsification: After a valid non-flat calibration, paired effects are within the frozen numerical equivalence region, fail multiplicity control, or required runs fail stationarity/precision requirements.

claims.text: The movement path and the production-decay source-sink path can be described without attributing a structurally impossible spatial feedback to production.
claims.falsification: The implemented causal paths do not match the registered estimands, a named disabled channel remains active, or a factorial contrast combines incomparable non-stationary cells.

claims.text: Any supported Cycle 4 landscape effect retains direction under separately designed system-size, density, grid-discretization, and holdout-landscape checks.
claims.blocked_by: C1-NUM-C4 and C2-LANDSCAPE-C4; compute is authorized.
claims.falsification: Effect direction reverses, falls inside the frozen equivalence region, or depends on conflated scale/density/grid changes.

experiments.objective: Decide whether the frozen numerical resolution limits cover the storage-order channel at the reference temperature (S18), by rerunning V1F's order layer with temperature 0.0 changed to 0.5 and nothing else.

experiments.execution: Submitted on umi at 2026-09-17 under jobctl pid 2149600; all 128 runs (64 seeds x canonical/permuted) completed in 13717 s (3.81 h). jobctl reconcile returned completed, and the verdict was recorded into the job dir by prepare_cycle4_confirmation.py record-diagnostic, which derives result.json and manifest.json from the report instead of transcribing numbers.
experiments.result: bounded: all four tail bounds fall under the frozen numerical_resolution_limits (0.001845 <= 0.004590 spearman; 0.001503 <= 0.003259 Moran; 0.000876 <= 0.000995 entropy; 0.001086 <= 0.001441 Gini). Ledger S18 is therefore closed as quantified, and no C++ change or recalibration is needed. Two reservations travel with the verdict and are pre-registered: occupancy_entropy has only 12% headroom (the tightest of the four, so any change raising its noise by more than 13.6% crosses the limit first), and 12 of 128 runs fail the per-run steady-window checks, which the design excludes from the verdict but which the bound inherits.
experiments.judgment: Pre-frozen in the design before submission: bounded if and only if all four tail metrics satisfy |mean| + 2*SE <= the frozen numerical_resolution_limits. Diagnostic only; it produces no evidence for any E1/E2 landscape effect and must not be cited as such.

experiments.objective: Extend the Cycle 4 numerical resolution limits to wealth_variance by re-analysing V1F's retained replicate_metrics.csv, publishing nothing unless V1F's four frozen limits reproduce bit for bit.
experiments.blocked_by: cleared: V1F's replicate_metrics.csv was retained in the job workspace and its sha256 matches the value V1F's config declared, so the re-analysis needed no simulator time, no GPU and no new seeds.
experiments.execution: Submitted on umi at 2026-09-18 under jobctl pid 3760366; 0.37 s of wall time (the job only reads a 5 MB table and runs no simulation) and jobctl reconcile returned completed. The verdict was recorded into the job dir by prepare_cycle4_confirmation.py record-calibration-extension, which hashes the source artifact on disk, re-reads V1F's four frozen limits from that file, and refuses to record an extension that rewrites, silently skips or re-freezes one of them.
experiments.result: pass: all four V1F limits reproduce bit for bit (0 mismatched float fields out of 144): spearman 0.004589992673223881, Moran 0.0032587589468579255, entropy 0.0009948207537034592, Gini 0.0014407792015185721. The extension adds exactly one limit, wealth_variance = 0.056828569227561854, taken from the worst cell (clustered) of the discretization layer; every cell passes its trend check and the order leg's finest-dt bound (0.005972) is below it, so the metric is bounded by discretization rather than by storage order. No ceiling is frozen: a ceiling is a pre-registered failure threshold, so it is left to be frozen with the scientific SESOI rather than written after seeing the data. mean_wealth stays out of scope (absent from the retained table; registered as a level audit, design section 15.5), which the artifact records explicitly instead of silently omitting.
experiments.judgment: Pre-frozen before submission: an extension may only add limits. It must reproduce every source limit exactly (a near miss is a fresh measurement of a different object, not a second opinion about V1F's), may not restate an already frozen metric as an extension, and may not invent a ceiling. The extended metric must additionally pass the data-derived criteria already defined in the calibration aggregator (trend_pass, bounded_by_discretization), which contain no arbitrary constant. Diagnostic only: the extension declares pathwise_claim false and is not evidence for any E2-C4 effect.

analysis_policy.confirmatory_unit: paired random seed across matched landscapes
analysis_policy.stationarity_and_precision: Separate verdicts; both are required for confirmatory effect estimation.
analysis_policy.multiplicity: Holm family-wise correction within each frozen confirmatory family.
analysis_policy.missing_runs: No outcome-dependent seed replacement; all failures are reported.
analysis_policy.calibration_policy: Flat terrain may test invariants but cannot calibrate resource-density correlation. Numerical resolution and minimum scientifically relevant effect are separate quantities. A calibration extension may only add limits: it must reproduce its source's limits bit for bit, may not rewrite, skip or re-freeze one of them, and may not freeze a ceiling (a ceiling is a pre-registered failure threshold and is frozen with the SESOI, not written after seeing the data). The loader accepts an extension only while it pins the sha256 of the artifact it extends; the recorder additionally verifies that pin against the file on disk before anything is committed.
analysis_policy.change_control: Any model, threshold, required-metric, or analysis change after outcome inspection creates a new lock/version and requires independent data.
